summary: Reset canary images loader-diag-reset (Download word 0x12345601) and loader-diag-reset-bl (Bootloader word 0x1234560d, mode 3): the run-006 loader family plus a six-hunk patch (entry PMU snapshot with clearing of a leftover Download/Bootloader request, a 45 s deadline measured from after the 83 s watchdog arm, RESET stage marker, RST report frames) and the unmodified NAT-042 reset module. Built twice with identical hashes; RECOVERY candidates (package-002) carry Image.payload verbatim at offset 2048 (hashes only); 48 host/aarch64-simulator tests; 49/49 mutants killed; NAT-046 decision text drafted, not dated. Nothing was flashed or run on the phone.
evidence_category: host-test (host x86 model + unicorn instruction-level simulation of the compiled loader); not a measurement of the S24

acceptance.1_build: build.py applies nat-022 patch_loader.py (--trig-hold --adt-aligned), the nat-022 marker library, then patch_loader4.py (6 exact-match hunks, each anchor once, all-or-nothing); the NAT-042 module is linked unmodified (hashes equal the nat-042 sources); both images build with the loader flags and are reproducible (build-001 and build-002 image and payload hashes identical).
acceptance.2_tests: test_nat044.py: 48 tests (system python: 33 run, 15 skipped for missing unicorn/capstone; interpreter with unicorn 2.1.4 + capstone: all 48). Layers: Patch, HostReset (real patched markerlib.c + markerlib4.c + NAT-042 module on x86 against a PMU register model), Build, Package, Aarch64 (the built loader.elf in unicorn: trigger at the deadline after the RESET frame decoded from the framebuffer bytes, vendor register order and values, bootloader variant, read-back failure triggers nothing and is reported, unarmed never writes, leftover request cleared and reported in the status frame, deadline armed only after the watchdog in the real recovery_guard) and compiled-code checks (dsb sy between the INFORM3 clearing store and its read-back; FPEN enabled before C). The deadline (45 s) is at most WDT (83 s) minus 20 s, enforced by build.py and tested. Mutation: 49 mutants (new code, patch hunks, build rules, package, decoder); 49/49 killed, 0 invalid (mutation-003). Earlier runs: mutation-001 (45 mutants) 42 killed, 2 survived, 1 invalid; mutation-002 (46) all killed; both led to test fixes documented in README.md.

loader-diag-reset-bl: Image sha256 87226d5246a906de28dfbfba2c479ca2698732c5103deca2b0f2654c899f8362, Image.payload sha256 b05349eb5bc048c3b78694c3f14b3e58def30a7f74b45bd0f3b6d229fb6ef936, RECOVERY candidate sha256 d4e1454c198379328c91fc63a5aaf26e58c1747e2b696ca1b92719211bedfebd.

In the instruction-level run of the compiled loader the PMU stores are INFORM2 byte 2 := 0x4e, INFORM3 := reason, reboot-cmd bits [2:0] := mode, 0x3c00 := 2, in that order, at the deadline (>= 45 s and < 45.05 s after the arm), after the RESET marker (0x41) was in the framebuffer; read-back failures (INFORM2, INFORM3, reboot-cmd) trigger nothing, are drawn as rc 2/3/4 and are not retried.

A leftover Download/Bootloader INFORM3 word is read before it is cleared, shown in the entry words, cleared with a read-back and flagged CLEARED or CLEARFAIL in the status frame (decoded from the framebuffer bytes).
start.S sets CPACR_EL1.FPEN and clears CPTR_EL2 before the first C call; zig cc emits q/d register copies despite -mgeneral-regs-only (also in the base loader), safe only inside the loader.
not_established: U1: that the loader's PMU stores reach the hardware; U2: that 0x3c00 := 2 resets without the ACPM STOP request; U3/U4: that S-Boot honours INFORM3 = Download / Bootloader. All are native measurements for NAT-046; unicorn and the host model have no caches, MMU or memory attributes and are not the S24.
That the reset marker is seen (milliseconds on screen). That the phone returns to Download Mode, or to Android, by itself.
findings: A vacuous 'no SIMD in the text' test (capstone disasm() stopped after two instructions) was replaced by the FPEN-before-C property and a per-function ordering check; a tautological status test was replaced by a decode of what the loader draws.

The first closure packaged the loader-only Image (no test covered the package); found while pinning the NAT-048 driver; corrected under decision 0020 (reopen) with a Package test layer, three mutants and package-002.
NAT-022's build.py already notes that zig cc emits SIMD with -mgeneral-regs-only; NAT-036's per-function SIMD test is sound.
